text_block_list.text:
On that day, a certain event was broadcast 
for Umamusume fans. 
Its name was---

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Umamusume Real Town-Building Simulation!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! 
This is the highlight event of the final 
day 
of the "Game Festival"!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume chosen as "Mayors" will 
compete to see who can develop 
their own town the most!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Splendid, 
a delightfully merry spectacle!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have been chosen as Mayor, 
as general of this army, I shall seize 
total victory!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A fusion of city-building sim and 
territory conquest--- 
that leaves plenty of room for tactics.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the Mayors, various Umamusume 
are 
also participating as "Star Residents"! 
Their presence will sway the tides of 
war~!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Each of them possesses a "Unique 
Structure," 
and how you forge alliances with them 
will be the key to your strategy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(...In the art of war, one must first 
secure vital 
transportation hubs. That will lay the 
groundwork for later. 
Therefore, that spot facing the main 
boulevard---)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I request entry! Oho, Yaeno! 
A "dojo" as thy unique structure suits 
thee well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am quite fond of it myself. 
Especially---

text_block_list.name: NPC Disciples
text_block_list.text:
"Master Yaeno!" "Teach us a kata, quick!" 
"Show us the Go-Go Yaegaki Style!" 
"It's the Adamantine Kata, right?! Right, 
Master!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I, too, now have disciples to guide. 
As their instructor---I must protect this 
dojo.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha. As ever, thou hast 
a soft spot for little ones.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet thou must surely realize, yes? 
...In this battle, choose the wrong 
commander, 
and this dojo may well be razed to the 
ground.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This is prime real estate. Because people 
and goods 
flow through here---it will be targeted. 
Many will approach 
seeking to erect something other than a 
dojo.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thus---discern true intent from falsehood. 
Under whom mayest thou best fulfill thy 
purpose?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
......Hypothetically speaking. 
If it were you, what would you do with 
this dojo?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Me? Why, I would naturally preserve it. 
For the prosperity of a dojo under Yaeno's 
care 
is plain for all to see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This dojo is "useful." 
Considering the gain it brings me, I could 
never demolish it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. 
Hearing your words has made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san. 
---Would you join forces with me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the world is this?! 
Such a venomous-looking liquid!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However... if a single cup grants me the 
Research Lab 
that will shoulder the town's future---it 
is a worthy sacrifice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, what a splendid chug! 
After seeing that, I can hardly refuse to 
cooperate! 
Care for a second glass?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Preserving the past for the future---as a 
lover of 
history, I too wish to aid that endeavor. 
As fellow comrades, wilt thou not lend me 
thy strength?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You've got quite the silver 
tongue, haven't you? 
I might just be tempted to lend you a hand 
after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Splendid, splendid! 
Formidable allies are falling right into 
my grasp!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, nothing in war is absolute. 
For now, we have secured the central 
thoroughfare—the key hub of transit— 
Now then, how will the enemy generals 
respond, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The secret to this game... is the "opening 
move." 
Namely, how effectively one amasses 
capital right out of the gate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The larger the starting fund, the wider 
one's strategic options. 
In other words, the first priority should 
be high visibility and prestige to attract 
crowds—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! My deepest thanks, Lord Rulership! 
You too wish to see my radiant beauty 
shine even brighter upon the grand stage! 
Ah, what a wonderfully sinful creature I 
am!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Besides, investing in the arts 
is a vital component of city planning.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Maintain our pact as agreed, 
and I promise my continued patronage.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, the opening preparations are 
immaculate. 
From here on... we enter the attack phase.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“At present, Mayor No Reason's city holds 
first place in overall score, including 
population, land area, and happiness 
rating! 
In second place is Mayor Rulership! And in 
third—”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... First place is mine. However, Lord 
Rulership breathes down my neck. 
I dare not let my guard down—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
D-Disaster, Lady No Reason! 
A defection! We have a defector in our 
ranks!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat in blazes didst thou say?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that settles it. 
I look forward to our partnership, 
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. With this, my laboratory shall 
expand grandly! 
My research shall take immense strides 
forward! 
I shall be counting on you henceforth, 
friend Rulership!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. 
As the shining beacon of intellect for my 
city, 
this research institute shall gleam with 
unrivaled splendor!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyaaah! Curse that Tachyon! 
After making me glow all shiny and bright, 
she went and betrayed me in the end!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...That 'Laboratory' she held possessed 
great value in bolstering a city's 
prestige. 
To have it wrested away... Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
W-What are your orders? Shall we open 
negotiations 
to win Tachyon-san back to our side—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nay, unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: For such a contingency, stratagems exist.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I have prepared one in advance. 
And a bountiful one at that—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
......"From here on, the city shall expand 
toward the east." 
Are you certain those were her exact 
words?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's right. 
Whether you choose to believe it or not is 
entirely up to you, of course.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(...If I take this intel at face value, 
I should move to secure the west. 
However—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This could very well be a ploy of hers. 
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(There are no further strongholds in the 
west. 
My intent was to dispatch his forces there 
and waste his precious time, but...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —He saw right through it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Nya-ha-ha-ha! 
Splendid, splendid. I have taken thy 
measure. 
Thou art an opponent worthy of my steel!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Agnes Tachyon has defected! 
With this, the tide of battle turns— 
and Mayor Rulership claims first place!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Since I am cast in the role of 
pursuer, 
from here on, I go on the offensive.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A certain legendary warlord had heavily 
armored warriors stand upstream, stem the 
river's flow, 
and traversed what was deemed an 
impassable rapid to launch a surprise 
raid!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Following that noble example—we shall 
erect a bridge right here! 
And draw forth a deluge of citizens from 
Lord Rulership's city just beyond!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, we shall construct an 
amusement park on this spot! 
So that even more souls congregate upon 
our lands! 
Up, up, make haste—!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, so that's your play! Very well. 
—I shall abandon that sector.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely for this reason that I 
dispersed my core strongholds across six 
points. 
Risk diversification proves its worth.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, if that is how you wish to play it— 
I shall respond with my full might.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A report from the front! 
A rival "Supermarket" has been erected 
near our shopping arcade!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
He seeks to siphon away the foot traffic 
from our very shopping arcade, does he...? 
Splendid! I shall meet him head-on!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now is the hour to loose our ready arrows! 
All hands, rally, rally! This battle—

text_block_list.name: Rulership & No Reason
text_block_list.text:
SHALL BE MINE!! 
Belongs to me.

It was just a casual watch of an event 
stream on my day off, 
but before I knew it, I was utterly 
hooked—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Even after pushing this far... 
Thirty minutes remain, yet... all options 
are exhausted.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...N-No... Nay, nay!! 
I refuse to lose!! To retreat in 
ignominious defeat, of all things...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
After fighting so fiercely, with every 
ounce of my being!!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mustering troops, devising grand 
stratagems, locking swords in a clash of 
wits— 
only for it to end like this... I-I will 
not accept it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...P-Please. Someone... I beg of you! 
Grant me victory! Turn this around 
somehowww!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I BEG YOUUUU—!!!! 
Waaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the final results. 
The victor is... 'Rulership'— 
and 'No Reason'! We have a tie for first 
place!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ......What. Can this be trueeee?!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It appears that in the final moments, 
several of Rulership's allies were swayed 
by No Reason's tears... 
and staged a defection!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously? You've got to be kidding me! 
A draw because of that? 
Talk about an absurd out-of-game 
tactic...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...*Ahem*. That said, I must concede. 
To put on such a pathetic display to 
garner sympathy and incite my allies to 
mutiny... 
that was a scheme born of terrifying 
obsession.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, obsession is far too grandiose 
a word! 
All I wanted was—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: To defeat thee. Nothing more.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To that end, let them mock me all they 
please. 
I would gladly make an utter fool of 
myself. I would even eat dirt.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that covetous prize I crave with every 
fiber of my soul 
lies right before my eyes, that is.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even so... 'twas a failure this time 
around. 
For the outcome was a mere "draw."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I cannot sheath my drawn blade like 
this... 
I know! Next time, let us duel at the 
Academy! 
And when that day comes, I shall have thy 
commander's head!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I welcome a rematch. Next time, I shall 
maintain absolute control of the board to 
the bitter end.

And so, the epic clash between the two of 
them as part of the gaming event 
became quite the hot topic among their 
fans.
